instructions: Moi file firmware co product, bootloaderSHA256 va build vid rieng. App doc /json/info.product de chon firmware, so khop bootloaderSHA256, sau do moi compare vid cua file da match. Thay url, size va sha256 bang file bin that truoc khi upload len server.

latest.notes: Build 2611260 cho ESP32-S3 N8R8. Co 3 file rieng cho HW board ARGB HSL Controller 4X, ARGB HSL Controller 2X Pro va ARGB HSL Controller 16X.

files.notes: Build 2611260 cho ARGB HSL Controller 4X: Timecode: nhieu mach chay khop nhau theo mot dong ho show chung, bam Phat la moi mach cung hien khung hinh dau (lech con khoang 1 ms, truoc day toi 31 ms), mach tu khoi dong lai giua show thi tu vao lai dung vi tri; Timecode: luu toi 7 show trong mot mach, preset "Show ke tiep" gan cho nut bam de chuyen show; Mach bao gioi han va ket qua moi lenh ghi cho app: gui anh, GIF, luu preset nhanh hon, file gui len duoc doi chieu dung luong va ma kiem tra; Hai lenh luu preset lien tiep khong con mat lenh sau; Doi so LED roi khoi dong lai: phan doan tu theo bo cuc LED moi; presets.json hong do mat dien dung luc ghi: mach tu lay lai ban truoc lan ghi gan nhat; Mach ghi lai nguyen nhan khi tu khoi dong lai do loi hoac sut ap de app bao va gui ky thuat HSL; Live view: app va trang web cua mach xem cung luc duoc (toi da 3 noi); Can Tool ARGB HSL v4.0.0 de dung cac tinh nang moi, Tool cu van chay nhu truoc.

Build 2611231 cho ARGB HSL Controller Lucky (ESP32-WROVER): Vong quay may man v1.0.0: cac mach xep vong tron sang lan luot vai vong roi dung o mot mach ngau nhien, dong bo qua ESP-NOW. Luc cho quay cac mach chay mau ngau nhien nhe nhang. Nhan Quay tren web UI (Cong cu > Vong quay), Tool hoac app.

Build 2611243 cho ARGB HSL Controller Lucky (ESP32-S3 N16R8): Lucky v1.2.2 - Link quay tu xa (ma QR) ghi kem so qua cau va nhom. Trang quay tu xa hien "Link cua qua cau so N", ke ca khi qua cau do mat dien, de biet can kiem tra mach nao. - Danh sach "Cac mach trong mang" co nhan "Quay tu xa" o mach dang phat link. Bam nhan de vao thang the Quay tu xa cua mach do, nhap PIN roi tat hoac tao link moi. - Remote cam tay khong phat link quay tu xa.
